titolo: OpenAI expands free ChatGPT for Academic Researchers to 200,000 scientists
descr: OpenAI will give 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to its frontier models via the ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program.
paragrafi: OpenAI announced on 16 November 2026 that it is widening its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program.
The expansion will provide free access to frontier models for 200,000 researchers around the globe.
The move targets scientists who need advanced AI tools for their work without cost barriers.
OpenAI describes the initiative as a step toward broader AI accessibility in research.
No details were given about eligibility criteria beyond the researcher designation.
perche: Researchers gain unrestricted use of cutting‑edge models, potentially accelerating scientific discovery. For users seeking free AI, the program shows a growing trend of major providers offering no‑cost access to advanced models.
